scene: Unrolling the tiny brass scroll reveals transit passes to three distant boroughs.
picture: Side-scrolling flat view along a cobbled terrace edge. On the far left sits an idling indigo night bus. Centre-left stands the tall Latino player in his teal bomber jacket, inspecting an open parchment scroll. To his right, an ornate ferris wheel gondola waits open, and on the far right stands an open brass book lift.
shown: a sleek indigo night bus idling at a stop pole on the far left
a glowing carnival gondola waiting at a platform ramp on the right
an ornate brass cage lift filled with stacked books on the far right
